units.source_text: 她把声音故意放低，说得柔媚婉转，装作小姐亲口说的模样。

en.t: She deliberately lowered her voice, speaking in a soft, sweet, and lilting way, as if the young lady herself were saying the words.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了，觉得这声音比起她的性格来，太亲昵些。

en.t: Prince Genji listened and felt that, compared with her nature, the voice sounded a little too intimate.

units.source_text: 但因初次听到，总觉非常可爱。

en.t: But because it was the first time he had heard it, he still found it very charming.

units.source_text: 便又说道：“如此，我倒反而无言可说了。

en.t: So he said again, "In that case, I find myself with nothing more to say."
